title: Sherpa-UI workflow definition
description: One workflow, as JSON: its nodes, their values, and the routes between their sockets. What each node IS comes from its kind. checkWorkflow() reads it. docs/history/plan-78-workflow-data.md

id.description: The workflow's id: its row in the store, and its draft, are filed under it.

label.description: Its name, as a reader sees it.

routes.description: Each joins an output socket to an input socket of the same kind. An input takes one route.

kind.description: What the node is: a kind the library ships (source, value, pick, filter, sort, group, count, output), or one the app adds.

x.description: Its place across the canvas, in plane px.

y.description: Its place down the canvas, in plane px.

heading.description: Its own name, in place of its kind's.

description.description: Its own line, in place of its kind's.

values.description: Each row's value, by the row's name.

socket.description: A node's header socket, "node", or a row's, "node/row".
